ends_at.description: When the window closes, or null for a moment rather than a window. The event reverses itself there — a suspend resumes, a spawner stop starts — so an action with no reverse cannot have one. A time-of-day at or before `starts_at` crosses midnight. Not `until`: this is when tonight's window shuts.

every.description: How often it repeats: `15m`, `1h`, `1d`, `2w`, `1 month`. Null fires once. With no `starts_at` this is dateless — the anchor is snapped to the unit, so `1h` means the top of every hour.

monthday.description: Day of the month, or -1 for its last day — the one thing `starts_at` cannot say, since months differ in length

nth.description: Which match to keep. With days ["fr"] and a monthly cadence, -1 is the last Friday of the month
